test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Shelley and Keats are great writers, but I prefer the last.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **the last.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrase 'the last' is incorrect.
 
• The phrase should be **'the latter'** to correctly compare two items, in this case, Shelley and Keats.
 
• When comparing two items, **'the latter'** refers to the second of the two mentioned items.
 
• Therefore, the correct form 'the latter' should be used in place of the incorrect form 'the last'.

Correct sentence: *Shelley and Keats are great writers, but I prefer **the latter**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **'latter'** is used to refer to the second of two items mentioned, while **'former'** refers to the first item.
 
• Example: *Both **Rome** and **Paris** are beautiful, but I prefer the **latter** (Paris).*
